SOFA Score (Sequential Organ Failure Assessment)

Predicts ICU mortality based on degree of organ dysfunction

Vasopressor doses in μg/kg/min for at least 1 hour
Original: Vincent JL et al. Intensive Care Med 1996
Score Range: 0-24 (higher = worse prognosis)
Mortality:
• 0-6: <10% mortality
• 7-9: 15-20% mortality
• 10-12: 40-50% mortality
• 13-14: 50-60% mortality
• 15+: >80% mortality
qSOFA (Quick SOFA): RR≥22, altered mentation, SBP≤100 (≥2 = high risk)
